result.description: Wright Horizons Childcare Pty Ltd  We are seeking a passionate and dedicated  Early Childhood Teacher  to join our growing early learning centre in Perth, Western Australia. The successful applicant will play a key role in delivering high-quality educational programs that support children's learning, development and wellbeing in accordance with the  Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF),  the  National Quality Framework (NQF) and our unique programming structure focused on intentional learning through an anchor and explore approach.    This is a full-time ongoing position with opportunities for professional development and career progression.    Benefits  Superannuation and pro-rata paid time off is included in the role. There are opportunities to expand the level of responsibility and involvement witht the centre.   Task & responsibilities   Plan, implement and evaluate developmentally appropriate educational programs for children aged 0–5 years.  Promote children's learning, wellbeing and development in accordance with the Early Years Learning Framework (EYLF).  Observe, assess and document children's learning and developmental progress.  Create a safe, inclusive and stimulating learning environment.  Build positive relationships with children, families and colleagues.  Ensure compliance with the National Quality Framework (NQF), National Quality Standard (NQS) and Education and Care Services National Regulations.  Maintain accurate records, learning documentation and individual learning plans.  Support and mentor educators to deliver quality educational outcomes.  Participate in staff meetings, professional development and continuous quality improvement initiatives.  Support and mentor educators across 0-5 years development ages.  Coordinate learning experiences throughout the year connected to learning goals, celebrated events and community engagement.  Plan, implement and reflect on programming structures and success across the centre. Initiative change and improvements where needed.  Be a Responsible Person.  Available for open and closing shifts.    Qualification & experience   Bachelor of Early Childhood Education (or recognised equivalent qualification).  Eligible for or currently holding Teacher Registration in Western Australia.  Current Working with Children Check (or ability to obtain).  Current First Aid, CPR, Asthma and Anaphylaxis qualifications (or willingness to obtain).  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.  Ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment.  Relevant Work experience of minimum 1 year or more  Manadatory Child Protection Training  Strong communication skills both verbally and written  Eagerness to learn and continue to grow   Leadership skills- strength, respect, ethical and compliant   About Company    Clarkson Safe n Sound is a trusted, family-owned early learning centre providing high-quality care for children aged 6 weeks to 5 years. We are a small, close-knit team with long-standing educators who create a warm, nurturing environment where children feel safe, confident, and genuinely known. Our centre is built on strong relationships with families, exceptional communication, and a commitment to supporting each child’s wellbeing, development, and individuality.  We offer a rich, play-based program designed to build the core skills children need to become capable, independent, confident thinkers and collaborators. Our philosophy focuses on emotional intelligence, problem-solving, curiosity, and world-ready traits that set children up for success in school and life. With all meals prepared fresh daily by our in-house chef, thoughtfully designed learning environments, and a supportive transition process for new families, Clarkson Safe n Sound is known for its warm community feel and high standard of care.  Educators who join our team value meaningful relationships, professional growth, and being part of a centre where their ideas, strengths, and passion for early childhood education are celebrated. Families consistently describe us as caring, communicative, and deeply invested in every child’s wellbeing — a reputation we are proud of and continue to uphold every day.
